title: Minimum opening.
officialText:
The minimum openable area to the outdoors shall be 5 percent of the floor area of the space being ventilated. Every window or other opening providing required natural ventilation shall be at least 1 foot (305 mm) wide and at least 3 square feet (0.28 m2) in total area, providing a minimum of 1½ square feet (0.14 m2) of openable area.
Exception: Skylights shall comply with the exception of Section 1203.4.1.4.
